About

I am an Electrical Engineering student at Al-Hussein Technical University (2024 to 2029). Lately I have been focused on robotics and electrical systems, from the electrical systems of a student Mars rover to a wearable safety device that won first place at the Orange Summer Challenge.

I like understanding why a design works and taking a system from component selection through to testing. I am keen to keep deepening my power electronics, battery and solar knowledge.
